articles.title: 07/31 First-Time Self-Checkout Experience
articles.titleZh: 07/31 首次使用自助结账体验

paragraphs.en: Alice: Wow, this self-checkout looks different from the ones I've seen in China. How do I start?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 哇，这个自助结账看起来和我在中国见过的不一样。我怎么开始呢？

paragraphs.en: Bob: It's pretty straightforward. Just scan your items, and then you can pay with your card or cash.
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 很简单。扫描你的商品，然后你可以用卡或现金支付。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Okay, where do I scan the items?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 好的，我在哪里扫描商品？

paragraphs.en: Bob: Over there, on the left side. There's a scanner right in front of you.
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 在那边，左边。就在你前面的那个扫描仪。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Got it. So, I scan each item and then what?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 明白了。那么，我扫描每个商品之后呢？

paragraphs.en: Bob: After you scan all the items, you'll see the total amount. Then you can pay and take your receipt.
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 扫描完所有商品后，你会看到总金额。然后你可以支付并取走收据。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Got it. I'm just a bit nervous because it's my first time. Do you have any tips?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 明白了。因为这是我第一次，我有点紧张。你有什么建议吗？

paragraphs.en: Bob: Just take your time and follow the instructions on the screen. It's really user-friendly. No worries!
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 慢慢来，按照屏幕上的说明操作。非常用户友好。别担心！

paragraphs.en: Alice: Thanks, Bob. I feel more confident now. Let's do this!
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 谢谢，Bob。我现在更有信心了。我们来试试吧！

paragraphs.en: Bob: You're welcome, Alice. I'm sure you'll do great. Let's go for it!
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 不客气，Alice。我相信你会做得很好。我们走吧！

articles.title: 07/31 Asking a Neighbor to Keep Noise Down

paragraphs.en: Emily: Hi John, could you please keep the noise down? I'm trying to sleep.
paragraphs.zh: Emily: 嗨，约翰，你能请把声音小一点吗？我在睡觉。

paragraphs.en: John: Oh, sorry, Emily. I didn't realize you were asleep. I'll try to be quieter.
paragraphs.zh: John: 哦，对不起，艾米丽。我没意识到你在睡觉。我会小声一点的。

paragraphs.en: Emily: Thanks, John. I really appreciate it. I had a long day at work.
paragraphs.zh: Emily: 谢谢你，约翰。我真的很感激。我今天工作了一整天。

paragraphs.en: John: No problem, Emily. If it happens again, just let me know. I'll be more careful.
paragraphs.zh: John: 没问题，艾米丽。如果再发生这种情况，就告诉我。我会更加小心的。

paragraphs.en: Emily: I will. And maybe you could use some earplugs to help with the noise.
paragraphs.zh: Emily: 我会的。也许你可以试试耳塞来帮助隔绝噪音。

paragraphs.en: John: That's a good idea. I'll look for some. Thanks for the tip.
paragraphs.zh: John: 这是个好主意。我会找找看。谢谢你的建议。

paragraphs.en: Emily: You're welcome. And John, remember, good neighbors make a great community.
paragraphs.zh: Emily: 不客气。还有，约翰，记住，好邻居才能组成一个美好的社区。

paragraphs.en: John: Absolutely, Emily. We're all in this together. Good night.
paragraphs.zh: John: 当然，艾米丽。我们都在一个社区里。晚安。

paragraphs.en: Emily: Good night, John. See you in the morning.
paragraphs.zh: Emily: 晚安，约翰。明天见。

articles.title: 07/31 Doctor's Appointment - Side Effects Inquiry
articles.titleZh: 07/31 医生预约 - 询问药物副作用

paragraphs.en: Dr. Smith: Good morning, Li Hua. How are you feeling today?
paragraphs.zh: Dr. Smith: 早上好，李华。你今天感觉怎么样？

paragraphs.en: Li Hua: Morning, Dr. Smith. I'm feeling okay, but I'm a bit worried about the side effects of the new medicine you prescribed.
paragraphs.zh: Li Hua: 早上好，史密斯医生。我感觉还好，但我对您开的这种新药可能产生的副作用有点担心。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Smith: Understood. It's important to be aware of potential side effects. Have you experienced any discomfort so far?
paragraphs.zh: Dr. Smith: 明白了。了解可能的副作用很重要。到目前为止，你有没有感到不适？

paragraphs.en: Li Hua: No, not yet. But I read online that some people might get dizziness or nausea.
paragraphs.zh: Li Hua: 还没有。但我上网查了，有些人可能会感到头晕或恶心。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Smith: Yes, those are common side effects. However, not everyone will experience them. It's also important to take the medication as prescribed.
paragraphs.zh: Dr. Smith: 是的，这些是常见的副作用。但是，并不是每个人都会经历这些。按照指示服用药物也很重要。

paragraphs.en: Li Hua: Okay, I'll make sure to follow the instructions. But what if the side effects do occur?
paragraphs.zh: Li Hua: 好的，我会确保按照指示服用。但如果真的出现了副作用怎么办？

paragraphs.en: Dr. Smith: If you do experience any side effects, please contact the clinic immediately. We can adjust the dosage or switch to a different medication if necessary.
paragraphs.zh: Dr. Smith: 如果你真的出现了副作用，请立即联系诊所。如果需要，我们可以调整剂量或更换其他药物。

paragraphs.en: Li Hua: Got it. Thank you, Dr. Smith. I'll be careful.
paragraphs.zh: Li Hua: 明白了。谢谢，史密斯医生。我会小心的。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Smith: You're welcome, Li Hua. Take care and don't hesitate to reach out if you have any more questions.
paragraphs.zh: Dr. Smith: 不客气，李华。保重身体，有任何问题随时联系。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Hey Bob, do you know the current exchange rate between the US dollar and the Euro?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 嗨，Bob，你知道现在美元和欧元之间的汇率是多少吗？

paragraphs.en: Bob: I think it's around 0.85, but I'm not sure. Do you need to check it for something specific?
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 我想大概是0.85，但我也不确定。你是不是需要查个具体用途的汇率？

paragraphs.en: Alice: Yes, I'm planning a trip to Paris and I want to make sure I get a good deal. Can you tell me if it's going up or down?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 是的，我打算去巴黎旅行，我想确保我能得到一个好的汇率。你能告诉我汇率是上涨还是下跌吗？

paragraphs.en: Bob: The Euro has been strengthening against the US dollar recently, so it might be a good time to exchange. But I'd recommend checking a reliable source for the most accurate rate.
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 最近欧元相对于美元有所升值，所以可能是个换汇的好时机。但我建议你查看可靠的来源以获取最准确的汇率。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Got it. Thanks, Bob. I'll look it up online. Do you have any tips on where to find the best rates?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 明白了。谢谢，Bob。我会上网查的。你有什么建议，哪里能找到最好的汇率吗？

paragraphs.en: Bob: You can try using a currency conversion app or checking financial news websites. They usually have up-to-date information.
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 你可以尝试使用货币转换应用或者查看金融新闻网站。它们通常有最新的信息。

paragraphs.en: Alice: That sounds good. I'll check them out. Also, is there anything else I should be aware of when exchanging currencies?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 听起来不错。我会去看看的。另外，我在兑换货币时还应该注意些什么？

paragraphs.en: Bob: Make sure to check for any fees or commissions the bank or currency exchange service might charge. Sometimes they can be quite high.
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 确保查看银行或货币兑换服务可能收取的任何费用或佣金。有时这些费用可能相当高。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Okay, I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for all the help, Bob!
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 好的，我会记住的。谢谢你的所有帮助，Bob！

paragraphs.en: Bob: No problem, Alice. Have a great trip to Paris!
paragraphs.zh: Bob: 没问题，Alice。祝你在巴黎玩得开心！

articles.title: 07/31 Software Engineer Job Interview Dialogue
articles.titleZh: 07/31 软件工程师职位面试对话

paragraphs.en: John: Good morning, Alice. Thank you for coming in today.
paragraphs.zh: John: 早上好，Alice。感谢您今天来面试。

paragraphs.en: Alice: Good morning, John. It's a pleasure to be here. How are you?
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 早上好，John。很高兴来到这里。你怎么样？

paragraphs.en: John: I'm doing well, thanks. Let's get started with the interview. Can you tell me a bit about your background?
paragraphs.zh: John: 我很好，谢谢。我们开始面试吧。你能简单介绍一下你的背景吗？

paragraphs.en: Alice: Sure, I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Beijing University. I've been working in software development for the past three years.
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 当然可以，我在北京大学获得了计算机科学学士学位。我过去三年一直在软件开发领域工作。

paragraphs.en: John: That's impressive. What kind of projects have you been involved in?
paragraphs.zh: John: 这很棒。你参与过哪些项目？

paragraphs.en: Alice: I've worked on a variety of projects, including e-commerce websites and mobile applications. I'm familiar with both front-end and back-end technologies.
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 我参与过各种项目，包括电子商务网站和移动应用。我对前端和后端技术都很熟悉。

paragraphs.en: John: Great, those are essential skills for this position. How do you handle pressure in your work?
paragraphs.zh: John: 太好了，这些是这份职位的关键技能。你如何处理工作中的压力？

paragraphs.en: Alice: I stay calm and prioritize tasks. I believe in taking breaks when needed and not overworking.
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 我会保持冷静，优先处理任务。我相信在必要时休息，不要过度工作。

paragraphs.en: John: That's a good approach. Do you have any questions for us?
paragraphs.zh: John: 这是一个好方法。你对我们有什么问题吗？

paragraphs.en: Alice: Yes, I'm curious about the company culture and the team I would be working with.
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 是的，我对公司的文化和我将要合作的团队很感兴趣。

paragraphs.en: John: Our company culture is collaborative and supportive. You'll be working with a diverse team of professionals.
paragraphs.zh: John: 我们公司的文化是协作和支持性的。你将与一个由专业人士组成的多元化团队一起工作。

paragraphs.en: Alice: That sounds great. I'm looking forward to contributing to the team and learning from everyone.
paragraphs.zh: Alice: 听起来很棒。我期待为团队做出贡献，并向每个人学习。

paragraphs.en: the /ŋ/ nasal sound (sing, think, ring)
paragraphs.zh: 在英语中，/ŋ/是一个鼻音，发音时舌尖抵住上齿龈，软腭上升，让气流从鼻腔通过。这个音在单词如'sing', 'think', 'ring'中出现。与汉语中的鼻音相比，英语的/ŋ/发音更为明显，且通常出现在单词的末尾。

paragraphs.en: sing /sɪŋ/  |  think /θɪŋk/  |  ring /rɪŋ/  |  long /lɒŋ/  |  song /sɒŋ/
paragraphs.zh:
sing /sɪŋ/ — 唱歌
think /θɪŋk/ — 思考
ring /rɪŋ/ — 铃声
long /lɒŋ/ — 长
song /sɒŋ/ — 歌曲

paragraphs.en: I can't sing a single note.
paragraphs.zh: 我唱不出一个音符。

paragraphs.en: Think about what you want to do next.
paragraphs.zh: 想想你接下来想做什么。

paragraphs.en: The bell rings at 7 o'clock.
paragraphs.zh: 铃在七点钟响。

extraData.explanation: 在英语中，/ŋ/是一个鼻音，发音时舌尖抵住上齿龈，软腭上升，让气流从鼻腔通过。这个音在单词如'sing', 'think', 'ring'中出现。与汉语中的鼻音相比，英语的/ŋ/发音更为明显，且通常出现在单词的末尾。

extraData.commonMistakes: 一些中国学习者可能会在发音时将/ŋ/与汉语中的/n/混淆，或者发音时舌尖没有正确抵住上齿龈，导致发音不准确。
extraData.tips: 为了更好地掌握/ŋ/的发音，可以多听英语原声材料，模仿发音。同时，可以通过练习舌尖抵住上齿龈的动作来加强发音的准确性。

articles.title: 07/31 A Chat at the Coffee Shop

paragraphs.en: Emma: Hi! I haven't seen you in ages. How have you been?
paragraphs.zh: Emma: 嗨！好久不见，你最近怎么样？

paragraphs.en: Jack: I've been great, thanks! Just grabbing a coffee before work. What about you?
paragraphs.zh: Jack: 我很好，谢谢！上班前来杯咖啡。你呢？

paragraphs.en: Emma: Same here. I come to this cafe almost every morning now.
paragraphs.zh: Emma: 我也是。现在我几乎每天早上都来这家咖啡馆。

paragraphs.en: Jack: It's such a cozy place. Their lattes are the best in town.
paragraphs.zh: Jack: 这地方很温馨。他们的拿铁是全城最好喝的。

paragraphs.en: Emma: Totally agree. We should catch up properly sometime soon.
paragraphs.zh: Emma: 完全同意。我们改天应该好好聚聚。

paragraphs.en: Jack: Definitely. Let's grab lunch this weekend. I'll text you.
paragraphs.zh: Jack: 一定。这周末一起吃午饭吧，我给你发消息。
